key.name: base-url
key.description: The base URL of the Home Assistant instance including protocol and port, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123

key.name: token
key.description: A long-lived access token generated from the Home Assistant profile page.

key.name: entity-id
key.description: The entity ID of the device to toggle, e.g. light.living_room

key.name: entities
key.description: Ordered entity IDs to show as buttons in the status page. Empty means show every entity from the cached Home Assistant list.

key.name: cache
key.description: JSON snapshot of the last fetched entity list. Used to render the quick-setting list offline and to avoid unnecessary requests.
